name: Voidek Auto Schema Generator – JSON-LD Rich Snippets for SEO & AI Search (AEO, GEO)
author: Voidek Webolutions

sections.description:
Turn your WordPress site into a structured, AI-ready asset — without writing a single line of code.

Voidek Auto Schema Generator automatically adds JSON-LD structured data for articles, WooCommerce products, and reviews — helping your content qualify for rich snippets, improve click-through rates, and become easier for search engines and AI systems to understand.

—

🎯 Who This Plugin Is For

This plugin is built specifically for:

– 🛒 WooCommerce store owners who want product rich snippets (price, stock, ratings) without manual schema setup
– ✍️ Bloggers & content publishers looking to enhance articles for Google Discover, News, and AI summaries
– 📈 SEO professionals & agencies managing multiple sites who need fast, automated structured data
– 🤖 Site owners preparing for AI search (AEO/GEO) like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity

If you want better visibility in search without touching code, this plugin is for you.

—

🚀 Why This Plugin Matters

Search engines and AI tools rely on structured data to understand your content.

Without it:
– Your site looks basic in search
– Lower click-through rates
– Harder for AI systems to interpret your content

With it:
– Rich snippets (⭐ ratings, price, stock)
– Better visibility across SEO, AEO & GEO
– Higher trust before users even click

—

📦 Everything Included – 100% Free

📰 Article Schema

– Headline, description
– Author & publisher
– Publish & updated date
– Featured image

Helps content appear in Google News, Discover & AI summaries

—

🛒 WooCommerce Product Schema

– Product name, images, description
– Dynamic price & stock status
– Brand & SKU
– Review ratings

Optimized for Google Shopping & rich results

—

⭐ Review & Rating Schema

– Star ratings (1–5)
– Review count
– Reviewer data

Builds instant trust in search results

—

⚡ What Happens After Installation?

  1. Install & activate
  2. Enable schema
  3. Done — JSON-LD is automatically added

No setup complexity. No developer needed.

—

🌍 Works Across Modern Search

Your structured data is used by:

– Google (Search, AI Overviews, Discover)
– Bing (Search & Copilot)
– ChatGPT & Perplexity
– Voice assistants (Alexa, Siri)
– Other search engines & crawlers

Supports SEO + AEO + GEO

—

📊 The Real Difference

🚫 Without Schema
✅ With Voidek Schema

Plain search listing
⭐ Rich snippets (ratings, price, stock)

No product details
📦 Stock & reviews visible instantly

Blends with competitors
🚀 Visually stands out in SERPs

Lower click-through rate
📈 Higher CTR & engagement

Hard for AI to understand
🤖 AI-ready structured data

—

🧠 Built for Performance

– No extra CSS or JS
– No unnecessary queries
– Lightweight JSON-LD output
– Works with caching & CDN

Your speed stays intact.

—

🔌 Works With Your SEO Plugins

Compatible with:
– Yoast SEO
– Rank Math
– All in One SEO
– The SEO Framework
– Any other SEO plugin

Adds schema without conflicts

—

🤖 Future-Ready for AI Search

Search is evolving:

– Google AI Overviews
– Bing Copilot
– ChatGPT Search
– Perplexity

These systems rely on structured data.

This plugin ensures your site is:
– Machine-readable
– Structured properly
– Easier to surface in AI results

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search Voidek Schema Builder
  3. Install & activate
  4. Enable schema in settings

Done.

—
sections.faq:
Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Everything works automatically.

Will Voidek Auto Schema Generator slow down my site?

No. Voidek Auto Schema Generator only adds lightweight JSON-LD.

Does Voidek Auto Schema Generator support WooCommerce?

Yes. Product schema is fully automated.

Does Voidek Auto Schema Generator work with SEO plugins?

Yes. No conflicts.

When will I see results?

Usually within a few days to weeks after indexing.
